caption: The drawing features a wooden cabinet positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The cabinet has a rectangular shape and stands on four straight legs. The upper section consists of three panels: the two outer panels have symmetrical dark brown and black ornamental designs, while the center panel features a circular floral motif and geometric patterns in brown and black with a touch of red outlining. Vertical black columns separate the panels, and similar columns are present at the cabinet's outer edges. Below, there are two wide drawers, each outlined in red and adorned with diamond-shaped patterns and brass-colored handles. The overall color scheme is dominated by shades of brown, black, beige, and red, with the wood grain rendered in fine detail.
title: Hartford Chest
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
